cards.name: Bilbo Baggins
cards.text: The first player gains control of Bilbo Baggins. Bilbo Baggins cannot gain resources from player card effects. If Bilbo Baggins leaves play, the players lose the game.

cards.name: Bilbo's Magic Ring
cards.text:
Attach to Bilbo Baggins.
Action: When answering a riddle, spend 1 [baggins] resource to discard an additional player card from the top of your deck.  Action: Exhaust Bilbo's Magic Ring and raise each player's threat by 2 to add 1 [baggins] resource to Bilbo Baggins' resource pool.

cards.name: Come down little bird
cards.text: When Revealed: Starting with the first player, each player must search the encounter deck and encounter discard pile for 1 Creature enemy and put it into play engaged with him. Then, shuffle the encounter deck.  Riddle: The first player names a card type and cost, shuffles his deck, then discards the top 3 cards. For each of those cards that matches both items, place 1 progress token on stage 2.

cards.name: Goblin Axeman
cards.text: Goblin Axeman gets +1 [attack] for each Cave location in play.

cards.name: Goblin Driver
cards.text: When Revealed: The first player exhausts 1 character he controls.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Defending player exhausts 1 character he controls.

cards.name: Goblin Miners
cards.text: Goblin Miners gets +1 [defense] for each Cave location in play.

cards.name: Goblin Runners
cards.text: Surge.
cards.shadow: Shadow: attacking enemy makes an additional attack immediately after this one. (Deal a new shadow card for that attack.)

cards.name: Gollum
cards.text: Forced: After the first player answers a riddle and fails to find at least 1 match, Gollum attacks Bilbo Baggins. (Do not deal a shadow card for this attack.)

cards.name: Great Gray Wolf
cards.text: Forced: If Great Gray Wolf is dealt a shadow card with a riddle, return all Creature enemies to the staging area at the end of the combat phase.  Riddle: The first player names a card type, sphere and cost, shuffles his deck, then discards the top 3 cards. For each of those cards that matches all three items, place 1 progress token on stage 2.

cards.name: Grip, grab! Pinch, nab!
cards.text: When Revealed: Starting with the first player, each player must choose 1 Goblin enemy from the discard pile and add it to the staging area.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Defending player deals damage among characters he controls equal to the number of Goblin enemies engaged with him.

cards.name: Hiding in the Trees
cards.text: When Revealed: Characters get -1 [willpower] and cannot attack until the end of the round.  Riddle: The first player names a card type and sphere, shuffles his deck, then discards the top 3 cards. For each of those cards that matches both items, place 1 progress token on stage 2.

cards.name: Into the Fire
cards.back_text: When Revealed: The first player gains control of Bilbo Baggins. Reveal 1 encounter card per player and add it to the staging area.  Gollum engages the first player. Damage from undefended attacks made by Gollum must be placed on Bilbo Baggins.  All riddle effects are ignored. Treachery cards gain surge.  If the players defeat this stage, they have won the game.

cards.name: It Likes Riddles?
cards.text: When Revealed: The first player must choose to answer the riddle on this card. If he finds at least 1 match, discard cards from the encounter deck until another card with a riddle is discarded. Then, answer that riddle.  Riddle: The first player names a cost, shuffles his deck, then discards the top 2 cards. For each of those cards that matches, place 1 progress token on stage 2.

cards.name: Lake in the Cavern
cards.text:
X is twice the number of players in the game.
Players cannot travel here.  Immune to player card effects.  Forced: After players advance to stage 3, remove Lake in the Cavern from the game.

cards.name: Not fair! Not fair!
cards.text: When Revealed: The first player names a card type and then discards the top 3 cards of the encounter deck. For each of those cards that does not match the named type, remove 1 progress token from stage 2. This effect cannot be canceled.

cards.name: Out of the Frying Pan
cards.text: Setup: Add Lake in the Cavern to the staging area. Create a riddle area with stage 2A and follow the setup instructions on that card.
cards.back_text: Players cannot advance to stage 3A unless both 1B and 2B are complete.  Forced: Reveal 1 additional encounter card per player during the staging step.

cards.name: Riddles in the Dark
cards.text: Setup: Search the encounter deck for Gollum and Bilbo's Magic Ring. Place Gollum and Bilbo Baggins in the riddle area and attach Bilbo's Magic Ring to Bilbo Baggins. Then, shuffle the encounter deck.
cards.back_text: Players cannot advance to stage 3A unless both 1B and 2B are complete.  Progress tokens cannot be added to, or removed from, this quest except by answering riddles.  Cards in the riddle area are immune to player card effects and cannot leave the riddle area except by quest effects.

cards.name: The Goblins' Caves
cards.text: While The Goblins' Caves is the active location, Goblin enemies get +1 [threat].
cards.shadow: Shadow: Defending player raises his threat by X. X is the number of Goblin enemies engaged with him.

cards.name: The Wargs' Glade
cards.text: Forced: After a character takes damage from an attack made by a Creature enemy, remove 1 progress from the current quest.  Riddle: The first player names a sphere, shuffles his deck, and discards the top card. For each of those cards that matches, place 1 progress token on stage 2.

cards.name: What's In My Pocket?
cards.text: When Revealed: The first player must choose to answer the riddle on this card. This effect cannot be canceled.  Riddle: The first player names a sphere and cost, shuffles his deck, then discards the top 2 cards. For each of those cards that matches both items, place 1 progress token on stage 2.

cards.name: Wild Wargs
cards.text: Forced: If Wild Wargs is dealt a shadow card with a riddle, it gets +2 [attack].  Riddle: The first player names a card type, shuffles his deck, and discards the top 2 cards. For each of those cards that matches, place 1 progress token on stage 2.
